publicationBoundary.existingNativeAnchors: Simulation1234-1270 validates construction and establishes owned state; Capture1273 returns Copy; commit1603-1624 adds receipt, fully validates or verifies checkpoint, then copies candidate and publishes state/checkpoint. Proposed builder must hook the final established state on both validation modes, not earlier partial candidates.
publicationBoundary.allProfile: Do not gate projection creation on PlanningPassage/VerifiedSharedWorldCheckpoint support. Ordinary full-validation factories also need it. Generation/stamp publication remains private and same owner/session gate.
publicationBoundary.rejections: Rejected or exact duplicate commands retain current established capability; temporary resolver candidate/journal objects must never become current projection.
publicationBoundary.failureIsolation: Actual successful legacy state/receipt remain committed if proposed derived projection build throws/returns wrong stamp/null; publish current-generation unavailable, never stale previous projection or false rollback. Trusted provider must not reenter Simulation/session; no callback sees new state with old projection.
publicationBoundary.inputMutation: Conditions and inspected profile-root closure are safe; full broad-Snapshot defensive-detachment assertion is not proven for every unrelated nested record by this report. A provider cannot be allowed to traverse/mutate uninspected objects and then cite this finite closure as whole-object proof.
publicationBoundary.consumerRead: All V1 current read helpers use exact current context. No ConditionResolutionScope fallback or Restore/Resolve/AdvanceTo at read time. Historical-prefix helper sources such as SharedTypedDamage46, route-mapping372 and temporary-camp212/466 do not become current projections.

concreteCounterexamples.fact: At the same RuleClock time with journal phase>0, replacing native ledger.Now with phase0 changes chronological semantics. At only advances if requested marker is later.
concreteCounterexamples.required: Preserve exact Origin/Now/operation phases and both mode markers; never rewind or normalize.

concreteCounterexamples.fact: Using projected ledger in HasUnprocessedConditionDeadline can make an overdue active application appear ended and incorrectly admit a command.
concreteCounterexamples.required: Use cached journal-time ledger for that exact guard; projected ledger for ConditionsFor.

concreteCounterexamples.fact: Caller-modified pre-Ferry Creatures or redundant roster phase can change behavior without changing limited unchecked encoding; original validators constrain actual owned state.
concreteCounterexamples.required: Same owning final validated state/canonical binding only, no arbitrary Snapshot authentication.

concreteCounterexamples.fact: Start and StartWithFishingTrap share wire95; WorkControl and OrdinaryMagicalActivity share wire116. Wire alone cannot distinguish actual selected capabilities, consent or owner/policy.
concreteCounterexamples.required: Bind actual selected content/policy and private generation; schema/wire equality alone is insufficient.

remaining.exact: 191 initialized arrays include procedure families not semantically consumed by condition materialization: HarvestDonors/Manifests/Attempts, Mining/Assay/Preparation/Recipe347 records, HavenAppraisals/Sales and ExpeditionBills plus retained episode/charter report subfamilies. Prior codec proves encoding, not all constructor alias closures. This finite report does not certify arbitrary provider mutation through those objects; inspect actual provider code's access footprint or finish the exact reachable child closure before claiming broad detachment.

No builder/context exists yet. Need actual same-generation publication, hostile detached-input mutation controls within exact admitted scope, rejected/duplicate retention, wrong owner/stamp/clock/mode/journal controls and failure-isolation/native parity for each24 selected factory/consent composition.
No full78-kind getter/deadline/permission/life/equipment/visibility transitive proof follows. Current projection is not a cached authorization, historical outcome or general replay exemption.
